blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Savi Davison and the PLDT High Speed Hitters continued their mastery of powerhouse Creamline, now winning seven of their last eight meetings in the PVL. Davison delivered 22 points as the High Speed Hitters handed the previously unbeaten Cool Smashers their first loss in the 2026 All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series, 25-19, 25-27, 25-23, 25-23, for their third straight win on Thursday night at Philsports Arena. “Every time you do it, you know you’re capable. And it’s almost like a disappointment if we don’t win. But it’s also hard to have that mindset because it’s a lot of pressure […]...
